Game Overview

The Chaser and the Pumpkin is a action game built around become a cunning pumpkin evading a relentless pursuer in this Halloween adventure. Navigate through 20 suspenseful levels, using quick thinking and tapping skills to escape. Strategic dodging and safe zones are your keys to survival in this thrilling blend of horror and action. Can you outsmart the Chaser?
